query: Can I bill C124 as MRP for a patient discharged after 3 days?

match_criteria.reason: Contains C124 billing requirements, MRP definitions, and length-of-stay criteria

expected_answer_elements: C124 is billable as MRP (Most Responsible Physician)
Patient must be admitted for at least 48 hours
3 days = 72 hours exceeds the 48-hour requirement
MRP designation requires physician to be responsible for majority of care
Cite: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Section C, Fee Code C124
expert_answer: Yes, C124 can be billed as MRP for a patient discharged after 3 days (72 hours). The Schedule of Benefits requires the patient to be admitted for at least 48 hours to qualify for the Most Responsible Physician (MRP) designation. Since 3 days exceeds this threshold, the billing is appropriate, provided the physician was responsible for the majority of the patient's care during the admission. (Source: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Section C, Fee Code C124)

query: What is the fee for a comprehensive assessment A003?

match_criteria.reason: Contains A003 fee code amount and billing requirements

expected_answer_elements: A003 fee amount
Comprehensive assessment billing criteria
Time requirements if applicable
Cite: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Section A
expert_answer: The fee for A003 (General Assessment) is $77.20 (as of 2015) or $84.45 (as of 2023), though current rates may vary. This code requires a full history and examination of all body parts and systems (excluding breast, genital, or rectal exams where not medically indicated or refused). The assessment must include additional investigations, coordination of follow-up care, and may include medically necessary procedures during the encounter. (Source: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Family Practice and Practice in General, Section A)

query: Which discharge codes apply for a Thursday discharge after Monday 2pm admission?

match_criteria.reason: Contains discharge code eligibility based on admission/discharge timing

expected_answer_elements: Calculate length of stay: Monday 2pm to Thursday
Determine which discharge code thresholds are met
List eligible codes (e.g., C122, C124, C126)
Explain timing calculation method
Cite: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Section C
expert_answer: For a Thursday discharge after Monday 2pm admission (approximately 2.5 days or 60+ hours), C124 with E083 (MRP premium) is the appropriate discharge code. The patient must be in hospital for at least 48 hours (2 full days) to qualify for C124. If discharged on the first day following admission assessment, use C122 with E083; if discharged on the second day, use C123 with E083. Since this patient exceeds 48 hours by Thursday, C124 applies, provided the physician is the Most Responsible Physician. (Source: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, General Preamble GP30, Payment Rule D)

query: Can I bill a consultation in the ER as an internist?

match_criteria.reason: Contains ER consultation billing rules for specialists

expected_answer_elements: ER consultation eligibility for internists
Specific consultation codes applicable
Any restrictions or requirements
Cite: OHIP Schedule of Benefits
expert_answer: Yes, internists can bill consultations in the ER using their specialty-specific consultation codes (e.g., A455 for Internal Medicine consultation), provided there is a written request from a referring physician or nurse practitioner. The consultation must be rendered to an unscheduled patient in the emergency department and must include an appropriate assessment and review of relevant data. Special visit premiums may also apply depending on the time of day and day of week. Note that Emergency Department Physicians must use H-prefix codes, but consulting specialists use their own specialty codes. (Source: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Consultations and Visits section; OHIP Hospital Services Quick Reference Guide)

query: What premiums apply for a house call to an elderly patient?

match_criteria.reason: Contains premium codes for house calls and elderly patients

expected_answer_elements: House call premium codes and amounts
Age-based premium eligibility
How premiums combine with base visit code
Cite: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Premiums section
expert_answer: For house calls to elderly patients (over 65 years with frailty criteria), physicians can bill A900 (Complex House Call Assessment) at $45.15, which applies to frail elderly or housebound patients. Additionally, travel premiums (K913/K914 depending on time/day) and first person seen premiums can be billed in conjunction with A900. An elderly, frail patient is defined as someone over 65 with complex medical needs, cognitive impairment, reduced mobility/falls, or unexplained functional decline. The premiums compensate for travel and unscheduled visits outside regular office hours. (Source: OHIP Schedule of Benefits, Special Visit Premiums section; OMA Home Care Billing Cheat Sheet)
